$comment: Single source of truth for which folders/files belong to which sellable edition.
4 buckets: shared (infra, always included, must never import UP into core/pro/premium),
core ⊂ pro ⊂ premium (each tier export includes shared + itself + everything below it).
Consumed by eslint.tier-boundaries.mjs (import-boundary lint) and scripts/export-tier.ts,
mirroring the pattern proven in the sibling `ims` project.
This is a skeleton: almost no application code exists yet, so most buckets are empty.
As features land, file/folder paths get added to the bucket matching PRD §6's phase they
belong to (MVP Core SIS + Finance -> core; Comms/LMS -> pro; Operations -> premium).
DEPLOYMENT_MODE (solo|saas, PRD §7) is an orthogonal axis, not a bucket here — a Solo
customer can buy any tier (core/pro/premium); this manifest only governs which FEATURES
ship, not which deployment mode they run under.
